company.name: Ray
company.shortDescription: Ray is a power bank sharing service with a network of portable charging stations.
company.description:
Ray is a technology startup in the hospitality and IoT sector that provides a power bank sharing network, allowing people to rent portable phone chargers from public locations such as restaurants, cafés, hotels, and entertainment venues.

The company is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and focuses on building a network of smart charging stations where users can quickly rent a portable power bank and return it at another station after use.
